integrity: The claim is supported by exact incidence congruences, exhaustive finite enumeration of all 48 lines and all unordered pairs, and an exact integer characteristic-polynomial calculation. The complete 48-line input is independently supplied by the cited literature.
scientific_limitations: The common-transversal count is internal to the complete 48-line set on the complex Fermat quartic. No claim is made about arbitrary ambient lines, spectral uniqueness, or automorphism-orbit classification.
title: Integral spectrum and transversal profile of the 48 Fermat-quartic lines
